title: Fake traffic fine
why: Fake e-challan messages send you to a copy of a government site to collect card details. Real fines are checked on the official parivahan portal only.
examples: Your vehicle has a pending traffic challan. Pay now to avoid court: https://echallan-pay.top/mh
e-Challan overdue, download app to pay: vahan_fine.apk
safe: Your challan of Rs 500 has been paid. Thank you.
Traffic will be heavy on the highway today.
